name: seongho-ops
description: Routes operational work to purpose-built local CLIs and packages Seongho's port cleanup utility.

interface.shortDescription: Route operational CLI work and provide the k port cleanup command.
interface.longDescription: Seongho Ops selects the correct authenticated local CLI for external services, infrastructure, databases, deployments, observability, browser QA, runtimes, and state-changing Git work. It also bundles the k command for force-stopping processes that own explicitly requested local ports.
defaultPrompt: Use the correct local CLI for this operational task.
Diagnose this CLI authentication failure safely.
Free this local port with the bundled k command.
